parts:
Hi everyone

Last chance to register for our upcoming seminars on survey sampling and questionnaire design.

Introduction to Survey Sampling:
This 2-day seminar is an excellent opportunity to gain a comprehensive introduction to survey sampling, a critical skill for designing effective surveys and analyzing sampled data. Running Jan 20 and 21 by professors Alexandru Cernat (University of Manchester) and Tarek Al Baghal (University of Essex), this seminar is ideal anyone who is new to survey research or looking to refine your understanding of this important method. This course will provide the foundational knowledge needed to confidently apply sampling techniques in your work. Participants will explore key concepts such as sampling design, estimation methods, and strategies to minimize bias and error. With a focus on practical applications, the seminar equips attendees with the tools necessary to design robust surveys and draw meaningful inferences from data.

Foundations of Questionnaire Design:
This 2-day seminar is an excellent opportunity to gain a comprehensive introduction to questionnaire design, a crucial skill for collecting high-quality data in surveys and research studies. Running Jan 29 and 31 by professor Daniel Schnitzlein (Leibniz University), it's designed for anyone looking to improve their ability to craft effective, reliable, and valid questionnaires. Whether you are new to questionnaire design or seeking to refine your skills, this course will provide the foundational knowledge needed to confidently design surveys that yield valid and actionable insights. Participants will explore key topics such as question formulation, response scaling, minimizing bias, and optimizing survey structure. With a focus on practical applications, the seminar equips attendees with the tools necessary to design questionnaires that enhance data quality and reliability.

Don’t miss this chance to learn from leading experts in the field—sign up today to secure your spot!


Best wishes
